Each pin named by what it carries at 10/100 Mbit/s and 1 Gbit/s, as a computer (MDI) has them; a switch (MDI-X) swaps transmit and receive. A straight cable has the same wiring at both ends; a crossover cable T568A at one and T568B at the other.
Mode A puts the power on the data pairs, mode B on the spare ones; 4-pair PoE (802.3bt) uses both. A powered device takes either polarity.
